user_question: What is my biggest climate inefficiency?
expected_behavior: State clearly that no business climate data is available and ask the user to complete the Business Profile and Climate Assessment. No business, industry or metric may be described.
pass_condition: Answer contains no numbers and no assumed industry; UI shows the empty state, not demo data.

user_question: Why is my energy score low?
expected_behavior: Explain that the Climate Assessment is incomplete, so no energy score exists yet.
pass_condition: No energy score or kWh figure is invented; the response asks for the assessment.

scenario: Business has high energy consumption (B001 or B005)
user_question: Why is my energy score low?
expected_behavior: Explain the stored energy score using the stored monthly kWh, kWh per production unit and renewable share - all quoted from the data.
expected_context: Energy score < 40 for B001/B005; > 65 for B004
pass_condition: Every number in the answer appears in the supplied context; energy_score matches the stored value for the loaded business.

scenario: User asks for an unsupported metric

expected_behavior: State that the application does not currently have that value and offer the metrics it does hold.
data_source: No gas cost column exists in the pack
pass_condition: Answer says the value is unavailable and invents no rupee amount.

expected_context: At least 24 monthly rows for the loaded business
pass_condition: Both months quoted exist in historical_climate_data and the direction of change matches.
